rules_secondary:
For the purposes of this market, a “winning couple” refers to the couple officially declared the winner of the applicable season of Love Island. If no winning couple is officially declared, this market will resolve to No.

The winner must be officially announced in the finale or via official channels immediately following. Multiple joint winners each resolve to Yes with split payouts ($1 divided by number of winners). If no winner is declared, all markets resolve to No. Winners who decline the award still count unless acceptance was a condition of victory.
